dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian Lim here. Calling about the investment candidates I looked through. Want a brief discussion before settling the instruction. I'm back in the office now, so can talk properly, but keep it short lah. Warehouse has been quite busy.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Certainly, Adrian. We can keep the conversation focused and leave the general account administration until it is convenient. Have you found somewhere comfortable to speak without interruptions?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Door closed already. Usually someone comes looking for me about deliveries, but my staff handling that now. Let me give you my particulars. My identification number is G five one nine two seven two one F. My date of birth is 30 October 1990.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Before we get into the candidates, is there anything about the format of your account updates that you would like us to note?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The long emails quite hard to get through. By the time I finish with suppliers, still got delivery issues waiting. Short summary at the top would help. Anything administrative needing my attention, put that near the front, not buried at the bottom.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that preference for our correspondence. We can keep routine messages concise and separate administrative requests from general information, while retaining the necessary documents. Would you prefer that we leave non-urgent account administration to email rather than interrupting your working day?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Email better. Calls during loading time, sometimes I cannot hear properly anyway. Today I'm at the desk, so no problem. We can leave the general paperwork there and talk about what I called for.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Let's turn to the candidates you reviewed. To start, there's Orion Global Income Fund, the income-focused bond candidate. The comparison candidate is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, which combines exposure across asset classes.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'll take the one you mentioned first, the income-focused bond candidate.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction fee is 0.5% of the transaction amount. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses, though I prefer less volatility lah.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend Orion Global Income Fund because its bond-focused approach fits your preference for less equity-driven volatility, and its pooled holdings spread exposure across issuers.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hmm, let me pull my notes closer. Got them beside the delivery sheets, all mixed together on the desk. Give me a moment to move those out of the way.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Take your time. I'm here, and the line is clear. There is no need to work around the other paperwork while we are speaking.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Found it. I want to buy. The amount I'm putting into this transaction is 50,000. For the quantity, put down 250 units. Use US dollars for the transaction. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including the corrected currency. Please proceed.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. That concludes the instruction discussion. I have also noted your correspondence preference. Any separate administrative correspondence can remain in email, rather than extending this call while you are at work.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel. That keeps things manageable. I'll look out for the account emails when I'm back at my desk later. Better get back to the warehouse now; can hear the office getting busy outside.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for calling. I'll let you return to your team. Have a good afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: You too. Bye.
